canonical_gate_c.reason: canonical counts are an identity-verified read of the existing #833 schema-26 full-census score report

legacy_pinned_profile.code_applicability: score reports whose quality profile is pinned or absent; relative_tla reports return before this fixed floor

canonical_profile.requirement: rule12_precedence top-1 must be at least the same-report tla3_baseline top-1

rf31_promotion_gate.metric: paired sections-present minus sections-absent top-1 lower bound

threshold_semantics.disambiguation: The legacy 29.7% fixed floor and the #908 skip arm's 29.702% observation are numerically close but govern different populations, selectors, execution scopes, and decisions.

candidate_presence.field_semantics: teacher_argmax means corpus.t_argmax is anywhere in the Rule1+2 candidate list; any_teacher_top3 means at least one token from corpus.top_tokens is present. These are not candidate-list rank cutoffs.

probe_depth_histogram.meaning: raw counts indexed by graded-prefix depth; 0 is root and 4 is full code

headroom.interpretation: The same-position deficit is real and arithmetically closable, but neither the crosstab nor candidate-presence counts establish a production remediation without a normative-runtime paired replay.

residual_alpha_zero_counterfactual.interpretation: Blanket removal of the graph residual cannot close the same-position deficit and is not a retained broad remediation.

reference_off_serving_908.limitation: The experiment used re-emitted base/skip/null artifacts and the independently selecting reference engine; the canonical release graph is a different byte identity, lacks SKMX/PSIB, and was not evaluated through the normative R4G1Runtime selector.

source.claim: Source presence alone is not serving evidence.

artifact.claim: The content-bound canonical release cannot reach the skip-mix lane.

bounded_remediation_order.action: Complete #933's single normative R4G1Runtime selector, section consumption, cross-surface ownership, content-bound report, and strict admission work before making a quality claim.
bounded_remediation_order.cheap_instrument: absent-section identity, planted SKMX and PSIB reachability, cross-surface candidate equality, and wrong-binding rejection
bounded_remediation_order.proceed_if: all structural falsifiers pass with zero mismatches
bounded_remediation_order.if_negative: NOT ESTABLISHED; repair the named structural failure and do not run a census

bounded_remediation_order.action: Re-emit two immutable canonical graphs with the production compiler at distinct worker counts and require byte-identical graph/report identities with SKMX and PSIB present.
bounded_remediation_order.cheap_instrument: two-build byte comparison plus section census
bounded_remediation_order.proceed_if: both sections are present and every content-bound output is byte-identical
bounded_remediation_order.if_negative: UNAVAILABLE or NOT ESTABLISHED; stop before quality replay

bounded_remediation_order.action: Run the first 6000 canonical held-out positions teacher-free through the normative selector, measuring paired TLA, sections-absent, shuffled-null, teacher-argmax and any-teacher-top3 candidate presence, rank, witness, and cross-surface rows.
bounded_remediation_order.metric: same-position top-1 and reachable candidate headroom
bounded_remediation_order.cheap_instrument: typed sample decision with exact internal absent-section census
bounded_remediation_order.proceed_if: zero binding/witness/cross-surface failures, non-positive shuffled control, TLA lower bound at least zero, lane lower bound at least +20 permille, and projected full census at most 60 minutes
bounded_remediation_order.if_negative: LIMIT, RETIRE, NOT ESTABLISHED, or UNAVAILABLE according to the typed failing condition; do not launch the census

bounded_remediation_order.action: If the sample isolates retrieval loss, improve bounded candidate presence first; only after retrieval clears its predeclared gate may a separate ranking/calibration change be tested on target-present positions.
bounded_remediation_order.reachability_arithmetic: the recorded teacher argmax is absent from the Rule1+2 candidate list on 26983/72130 positions and present-but-not-selected on 27552/72130; each child must declare which disjoint ceiling it can touch
bounded_remediation_order.cheap_instrument: status-split teacher-argmax/any-teacher-top3 presence and teacher-rank replay on at most the 6000-position sample
bounded_remediation_order.proceed_if: the proposed child reaches enough same-position errors to close its declared target without regressing the other lane
bounded_remediation_order.if_negative: retire that intervention and retain the measured baseline; do not broaden search or weaken a gate

bounded_remediation_order.action: Run the full 72130-position normative census only after a typed PROCEED from the sample; bind and publish every positive, negative, or unavailable terminal artifact.
bounded_remediation_order.metric: full-census Rule1+2 versus same-position TLA and sections-absent paired effects
bounded_remediation_order.proceed_if: projected wall time remains at most 60 minutes and the sample can still change the decision
bounded_remediation_order.if_negative: retain the sample verdict; no hours-class run is authorized

evidence_links.role: canonical bundle attestation and score rows
